seo.metaTitle: Create Solid Color PNG - Free Flat Color Rectangle
seo.metaDescription: Generate a solid color PNG of any size in your browser: pick a color, set width and height, download. Free, no upload, no signup, no limits.
seo.longDescription: Create solid color PNG fills a rectangle of any size you like with one color: you set the width, the height and the color, and every pixel is filled with it, fully opaque — there is no transparency in the result. There is no source file: the rectangle is generated on your device. Use it for a background plate under a layout, a mask shape, a color sample in a spec, or a canvas that other tools on this site can then work on.
facts: Generated entirely in your browser: no upload, no server, no signup.
Canvas from 1 to 20000 pixels per side, with presets.
Always fully opaque — for a see-through sheet use the create empty PNG tool.
A 20000 by 20000 canvas is 400 million pixels and takes a moment.
Free with no daily limit, no watermark and no account, also for commercial use.
howTo: No upload needed - the rectangle is generated from the size and color you set.
Set Width and Height in pixels, or pick one of the presets such as a square or a screen size.
Choose the Color to fill the rectangle with.
Download the solid image as PNG, JPG, WebP or BMP from the Download button.

faq.q: Can I make a solid color image with transparency?
faq.a: Not on this page - every pixel is written fully opaque. If you need a semi-transparent sheet of one color, use the create empty PNG tool and set Opacity to anything below 100.

faq.q: How large can the canvas be?
faq.a: From 1 to 20000 pixels per side, with presets for the usual targets. The top end is genuinely heavy - 20000 by 20000 is 400 million pixels - so allow a moment and expect your browser to use a lot of memory.

faq.q: Does the file come out as a real PNG?
faq.a: Yes. It is encoded by the browser as a genuine PNG, not a renamed blank file, so it opens in any viewer and works as the source image for the editing tools on this site.

faq.q: Is it free to use commercially?
faq.a: Yes - no account, no upload, no watermark and no daily limit, and the project is open source.
